description: Search for Magic: The Gathering cards by name, type, color, mana cost, rarity, set, format legality, or keyword. Use this when you need to find cards matching specific criteria. Supports full-text search across card names, type lines, and oracle text. Returns a summary list — use get_card for full details on a specific card.

colors.description: Filter by colors (JSON array contains all specified)

keyword.description: Filter by keyword in keywords JSON array

query.description: Free-text search (FTS5) across name, type_line, oracle_text

rarity.description: Filter by rarity (common, uncommon, rare, mythic)

name: search_cards
